verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS company-formation and back-office platform. Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a web app of this kind, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or cookie controls, a privacy settings page, or any opt-out mechanism, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
